assets.label: hydrocarbon transfer pumps
assets.service: hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment
controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels
integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: potential incident - chemical exposure at P-4103

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels had been bypassed, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment on P-4103, M-4103 and TT-4103 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in managing hydrocarbon transfer and storage, specifically bunding, drainage and spill containment. P-4103 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was not in place. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 24 December 2020 a potential incident was recorded on P-4103, M-4103 and TT-4103 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during commissioning of replacement equipment; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
